response.sql:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(budget.amount - budget.spent) as baseline_avg
  FROM budget
  WHERE budget.amount IS NOT NULL AND budget.spent IS NOT NULL
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    budget.event_status,
    AVG(budget.amount - budget.spent) as average
  FROM budget
  WHERE budget.amount IS NOT NULL AND budget.spent IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY budget.event_status
)
SELECT
  status_averages.event_status,
  status_averages.average,
  status_averages.average - baseline.baseline_avg as difference_from_baseline
FROM status_averages
CROSS JOIN baseline
WHERE baseline.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: A 'missing difference' occurs when either amount or spent is NULL, causing the subtraction to yield NULL. Rows with NULL in either column are excluded from both the baseline and per-status averages.
